use generated_dmn::{Value, evaluate};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
fn encode(value: &Value) -> String {
    match value {
        Value::Null => "N".into(),
        Value::Boolean(true) => "T".into(),
        Value::Boolean(false) => "F".into(),
        Value::Text(text) => format!("S{text}"),
        Value::Number { coefficient, scale } => format!("D{coefficient},{scale}"),
        Value::Record(fields) => format!(
            "R{}",
            fields
                .iter()
                .map(|(k, v)| format!("{k}:{}", encode(v)))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join("|")
        ),
        _ => panic!("unexpected date result"),
    }
}
#[test]
fn constraints_match_java_input_and_result_binding() {
    let mut count = 0;
    for line in include_str!("constraint_vectors.tsv").lines() {
        let columns: Vec<_> = line.split('\t').collect();
        let scenario: usize = columns[1].parse().unwrap();
        let number = |n: &str| Value::Number {
            coefficient: n.into(),
            scale: 0,
        };
        let details = if scenario == 5 {
            Value::Null
        } else {
            Value::Record(BTreeMap::from([(
                "Score".into(),
                if scenario == 7 {
                    Value::Null
                } else {
                    number(if scenario == 1 { "11" } else { "5" })
                },
            )]))
        };
        let profile = if scenario == 6 {
            Value::Null
        } else {
            Value::Record(BTreeMap::from([
                ("Details".into(), details),
                (
                    "Code".into(),
                    Value::Text(if scenario == 2 { "blocked" } else { "ok" }.into()),
                ),
                ("Enabled".into(), Value::Boolean(scenario != 3)),
                (
                    "When".into(),
                    if scenario == 8 {
                        Value::Null
                    } else if scenario == 4 {
                        Value::Date {
                            year: 2023,
                            month: 12,
                            day: 31,
                        }
                    } else {
                        Value::Date {
                            year: 2024,
                            month: 2,
                            day: 29,
                        }
                    },
                ),
            ]))
        };
        let input = if columns[0] == "null" {
            Value::Null
        } else {
            number(columns[0])
        };
        let actual = evaluate(&BTreeMap::from([
            (("urn:rust-proof:tables", "input"), input),
            (("urn:rust-proof:tables", "profile-input"), profile),
        ]));
        if columns[2] == "ERROR" {
            assert!(actual.is_err(), "{line}");
        } else {
            let results = actual.unwrap();
            let actual = results
                .iter()
                .map(|((_, id), value)| format!("{id}={}", encode(value)))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join(";");
            assert_eq!(actual, columns[2], "{line}");
        }
        count += 1;
    }
    assert_eq!(count, 63);
}
